test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 7 persons P, Q, R, S, T, W and A are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only W and A are to the right of Q. Number of persons to the left of R are same as number of persons to the right of Q. P is third to the left of T. If W is to the left of A, then how many persons are sitting between P and A?
solution: **Given:** 7 persons P, Q, R, S, T, W and A are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). 1. Only W and A are to the right of Q. 2. Number of persons to the left of R are same as number of persons to the right of Q. 3. P is third to the left of T. 4. W is to the left of A.
